proof_body:
by
  intro K _ p _ _
  constructor
  · intro _ y
    haveI : PerfectRing K p := PerfectField.toPerfectRing p
    exact (PerfectRing.bijective_frobenius (R := K) (p := p)).2 y
  · intro h
    haveI : PerfectRing K p := PerfectRing.ofSurjective K p h
    exact PerfectRing.toPerfectField K p
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p], PerfectField K ↔ ∀ y : K, ∃ x : K, x ^ p = y
